_doc: Kin XP earned on the farm, so the game is playable without expeditions (DECISIONS 2026-11-09; docs/GARDEN.md Pace). scripts/home/garden_xp.gd reads it; the level table is 100 XP x level (Game.gain_xp). An expedition gives 40 (+40 on a win, +10 a knock). feed/pet/fetch are per action (love = the favourite food, or the favourite play); drill is per training point. The pace assumptions are what tools/garden_pace_check.gd models; session_min and base_sessions are how long one sitting is and how many a base-only player gets to their first baby (tools/base_breed_check.gd).
